description: Phase 3 of #939: AGRO becomes the canonical external identity — in-place rename to mifunedev/agro and mifunedev/agro-web, the docs pipeline adopts the .agro/ source contract, agro.mifune.dev is canonical, release metadata and dispatch use AGRO names, and every oh.mifune.dev entry URL stays shell-safe.

userStories.title: Web pipeline accepts the AGRO source layout before any rename
userStories.description: As the docs site, I build and mirror from .agro/ so the next core release cannot break oh.mifune.dev/oh.js, /get-oh.sh, and the site build.
acceptanceCriteria: In mifunedev/openharness-web, scripts/oh-source.mjs resolves AGRO_GITHUB_REPO then OH_GITHUB_REPO (default stays mifunedev/openharness until US-006) and AGRO_SCRIPTS_REF then OH_SCRIPTS_REF; it warns when both are set and differ and never prints values.
The CLI build script builds from .agro/cli when present and falls back to .oh/cli; it writes static/agro.js and static/oh.js from one build; both start with #!.

scripts/sync-external-scripts.mjs mirrors .agro/scripts/get-agro.sh -> static/get-agro.sh and .agro/scripts/get-oh.sh -> static/get-oh.sh with a .oh/scripts/ fallback; a missing canonical file at the pinned ref fails the build naming the path.

.github/workflows/pages.yml triggers on repository_dispatch types [agro-release, openharness-release], reads client_payload.ref for both, and its repository assertions accept mifunedev/agro-web and mifunedev/openharness-web.
pnpm run build succeeds against mifunedev/openharness@development (post-rename) and @main (pre-rename); the four static artifacts exist after each; pnpm run check:docs-drift passes.
Opened as a PR in mifunedev/openharness-web from a dedicated worktree; its URL is recorded in progress.txt and evidence.md; it is safe to merge before the rename.
userStories.notes: web PR https://github.com/mifunedev/openharness-web/pull/46 (feat/943-agro-source-layout@05e81c7); merge before the rename

userStories.title: Core repository metadata, installers, and links name AGRO
userStories.description: As a reader of the repository, npm, or the image, I see the AGRO repository as the source, and old names only where they document compatibility or history.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/cli/package.json and .agro/cli/legacy/package.json homepage, repository.url, and bugs.url point at github.com/mifunedev/agro.
.devcontainer/Dockerfile org.opencontainers.image.source is https://github.com/mifunedev/agro.
README.md badges, DeepWiki link, docs-site links, canonical-repo sentence, and installer one-liners use mifunedev/agro and agro.mifune.dev; the docs-site source link names mifunedev/agro-web.
.agro/scripts/get-agro.sh default AGRO_GITHUB_REPO is mifunedev/agro; get-oh.sh keeps oh.mifune.dev/get-oh.sh and /oh.js as documented endpoints and its OH_GITHUB_REPO default becomes mifunedev/agro.

Current docs use the AGRO repository and site; docs/agro-compatibility.md moves the Phase 3 items out of 'left for later phases' and lists each retained oh.mifune.dev endpoint with its SLA classification.
.agro/skills/sync/references/topology.md names github.com/mifunedev/agro as upstream; git, release, and strategic-proposal skill instructions use the new name.

Historical files untouched (CHANGELOG entries, docs/rfcs, dated task folders, crons/prompt-miner.md history); .agro/tasks/agro-identity-cutover/reference-classification.md classifies every remaining mifunedev/openharness and oh.mifune.dev hit as historical, compatibility, test-fixture, or generic.

Probes pinning the old name (get-oh-bootstrap, get-agro-bootstrap, oh-shipped-repo-overridable, oh-sandbox-image-mode, sync-skill-contract, docs-build-fast-path, agents-identity-contract, docs-20260901-followup-artifact-cited) pin the canonical name where intent is 'canonical product documented' and accept the legacy name only where they guard compatibility; each changed probe is fault-injected with the injection recorded.
pnpm test, both typechecks, link-providers.sh --check, and /eval are green.
userStories.notes: commit 03c3d69b; CLI defaults (self-upgrade agro.js URL, docs.ts, remote.ts, image ref, service Documentation= URLs) classified compatibility and deferred to the US-006 canonical-defaults flip

userStories.title: Release infrastructure uses AGRO names and notifies the docs site
userStories.description: As the release operator, I get AGRO-named release machinery that still publishes the legacy aliases, and the docs mirror refreshes on every release.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/release.yml smoke sandbox names are agro-release-smoke-<run>; IMAGE_REPOSITORIES default order is 'agro openharness'; the four image tags and the alias digest check are unchanged.
.agro/scripts/reserve-github-release.mjs user agent is agro-release-reservation; release-reservation.test.ts fixtures follow.

A notify-docs job runs after finalize on a real release (publishedNoop == 'false'), sends repository_dispatch agro-release with client_payload.ref = released sha to ${{ vars.AGRO_WEB_REPO || 'mifunedev/openharness-web' }} using secret AGRO_WEB_DISPATCH_TOKEN, is skipped with a visible notice when the secret is absent, and never prints the token.
The release documentation and .agro/skills/release/SKILL.md describe the dispatch, the token scope, gh secret set, and the GHCR package mifunedev/agro prerequisite.
Workflow YAML validates; the whole-diff leading-whitespace pair scan reports zero pairs.
userStories.notes: commit 4d80868b; released sha source needs.reserve.outputs.releaseSha; token scope contents: write on the docs repo

userStories.title: Docs site identity, domain, and SEO become AGRO
userStories.description: As a visitor, I reach agro.mifune.dev, see AGRO branding, and every edit, source, and navigation link points at the AGRO repositories.
acceptanceCriteria: docusaurus.config.ts: title AGRO, tagline updated, url https://agro.mifune.dev, organizationName mifunedev, projectName agro-web, docs and blog editUrl under mifunedev/agro-web, navbar/footer GitHub and LICENSE links under mifunedev/agro-web and mifunedev/agro, blog feed title updated.
static/CNAME is agro.mifune.dev; static/robots.txt sitemap URL updated; package.json name is agro-web.

scripts/render-blog-banner.mjs product title and terminal branding read AGRO; regenerated banner assets committed; historical blog posts and promos unchanged; a short 'OpenHarness is now AGRO' note is on the docs landing page.

Current docs pages use agro.mifune.dev, mifunedev/agro, get-agro.sh, and agro.js, and present get-oh.sh / oh.js only under a compatibility heading; check-docs-drift.mjs flags legacy host and repo names outside blog/, promos/, and compatibility sections.
pnpm run build passes; built sitemap.xml, feeds, and canonical links use https://agro.mifune.dev.
Delivered on a web-repo PR that is not merged before the operator activates the domain in US-006.
userStories.notes: draft web PR https://github.com/mifunedev/openharness-web/pull/47 (feat/943-agro-web-identity@73a06e7, stacked on #46); no banner asset regenerated because no current-default recipe exists; merge only after the Pages domain is active (US-006)

userStories.title: Cutover runbook with rollback
userStories.description: As the operator, I have one ordered, copy-pasteable procedure for the external actions, the checks that prove each one, and the way back.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/agro-cutover-runbook.md exists, is linked from docs/agro-compatibility.md, and passes bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh.

Preconditions: US-001 web PR merged; core PR green; operator admin on both repositories and the Cloudflare zone; agro.mifune.dev DNS present; GHCR package mifunedev/agro public; dispatch token issued.

Ordered actions with exact commands: record IDs and endpoint statuses; gh repo rename agro and agro-web; update description/homepage/topics; Pages custom domain agro.mifune.dev and merge the US-004 PR; Cloudflare 301 rule oh.mifune.dev/* -> agro.mifune.dev/$1 excluding the five executable paths, plus per-path rules that keep returning a script body; gh secret set AGRO_WEB_DISPATCH_TOKEN; origin update only when the normalized URL equals the old canonical repo.

Verification matrix: curl -fsSL of all ten endpoint/host pairs returns a #! body; gh repo view of the old name resolves to mifunedev/agro; git ls-remote of the old URL works; ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:latest and the openharness alias share a digest; the dispatched pages.yml run is green.
Rollback: Pages domain back, Cloudflare rules disabled, dispatch skipped by removing the secret; repository renames are not reverted; migrated filesystem state is never reverted.
userStories.notes: docs/agro-cutover-runbook.md; Cloudflare rules stated as Redirect Rules with dashboard fields and the rulesets API payload; existing /install.sh mechanism is a placeholder the operator identifies

userStories.title: Operator cutover and canonical defaults
userStories.description: As the operator, I perform the external actions from the runbook, and the build then flips the last defaults that could not point at mifunedev/agro before it existed.
acceptanceCriteria: The operator has run runbook steps 1-8 and the recorded outputs (repository IDs before/after, gh repo view names, endpoint matrix, Pages status) are in .agro/tasks/agro-identity-cutover/cutover-record.md; skipped steps are listed with reasons. This story blocks until the operator reports completion.
Web repo default source becomes mifunedev/agro; static/install.sh is not added; the US-004 PR is merged.
Core README, get-agro.sh, and get-oh.sh one-liners are re-verified live from a clean node:22-slim container via agro.mifune.dev/get-agro.sh and oh.mifune.dev/get-oh.sh.
sandbox-boot-guard.yml LEGACY_IMAGE still references the legacy GHCR name on purpose and sandbox-boot-guard-ci passes.

Release smoke: the next release from main publishes both image names with equal digests and the notify-docs dispatch triggers a green pages.yml run, with run URLs recorded; a workflow_dispatch of pages.yml with ref=main stands in when no release is due and is labelled as such.
userStories.notes: Runbook steps 1-6, 7b and 8 performed and recorded in cutover-record.md; step 7a (AGRO_WEB_DISPATCH_TOKEN) deferred and listed with its reason, which AC1 permits. All ten endpoint pairs verified; clean-container installs pass from both hosts; release dispatch covered by the workflow_dispatch stand-in that AC5 permits.

userStories.title: Knowledge impact, classification, changelog, evidence

acceptanceCriteria: release-versioning and fresh-machine-setup are updated (dispatch job, repository names, agro.mifune.dev, installer endpoints) with verified_at advanced to a full SHA whose tree was re-read; oh-cli-portable-lifecycle reverified if its claims name the download host.

A new kind: repo page agro-web-pipeline documents the docs-site source contract (resolver, mirror, dispatch, Pages assertions, CDN-owned /install.sh) with sources pinned to web repository paths and commit.
.agro/knowledge/README.md regenerated; wiki probes pass; knowledge-impact.sh --verified reports no NEEDS-REVIEW.
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry references #943 and states the rename, the canonical domain, and the retained compatibility endpoints.

evidence.md links the web PR(s), the cutover record, the endpoint matrix before and after, the dispatch run, the release smoke, the probe fault injections, and the classified reference list; eval-result.json is written at the final commit.
userStories.notes: Knowledge pages updated and pinned, agro-web-pipeline corrected to the observed edge configuration, index regenerated, CHANGELOG entry, evidence.md keyed to the final commit. Release smoke covered by the stand-in the criterion permits; the dispatch token is deferred and disclosed.
